note: East Campground of Lake Ogallala SRA, on the wooded peninsula at the east entrance off the Keystone Lake road, just below Kingsley Dam: paved electric plus back-ins with water, many along the shore of the 320-acre Lake Ogallala. Restroom and shower building. A trout fishery; the West Campground (grass basic sites) is across the lake by the west entrance. --Claude
summary: RA: 82 paved EP sites, 50 A + water, 45-ft back-ins; showers; reservation only. Fees 25-30 +5 weekend confirmed (June 2027 quotes $30/$35). Booking platform operator -> reserveamerica, fcfs never, window 180, url. Season year_round true added. Hookups gain electric 50, sites count 82 added. Lakefront confirmed. Pin 252 m from the site centre; move suggested. Phone 308-284-8800 confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT confirmed lakefront: on NAIP the peninsula's perimeter pads (GIS 007, 037, 042, 067, 062) sit 10-30 m from the Lake Ogallala shore with open, lightly treed ground between, and no road between pad and water. ReserveAmerica's list shows 'Near Water - no' on every site, but that is the list's default at every NE park, so it does not count against. Below Kingsley Dam, but the campground is on Lake Ogallala itself, the water it is judged against (stored dam screen agrees).
PIN: stored 41.22852,-101.66105 is at the peninsula's north neck by site 001, 252 m from the GIS centre of the sampled East sites, 41.22641,-101.66212. Just over the 250 m line; move if wanted.

SPLIT CANDIDATE: Lake Ogallala West Campground - 100 reservable 'Basic' grass sites (RA loop 'WEST CAMPGROUND', W1-W100), 'spread across multiple locations on the west side of Lake Ogallala and includes many lake front sites', at its own West Entrance off the Keystone Lake road. Sampled GIS centre 41.22387,-101.66742, 745 m west of the stored pin across the lake and spread 2.3 km north-south (41.2131-41.2342); it is a separate drive, not reachable through the East Campground. Not in the database. Basic $15 Sun-Wed / $20 Thu-Sat in season (2026-10-12 quotes on W1/W2), $10 off-season. RA posts no lengths or surfaces for its sites.
BOOKING: stored platform 'operator' -> 'reserveamerica' (NGPC books through nebraskastateparks.reserveamerica.com); fcfs 'never' from the RA text 'all camping ... by advanced reservation only'.
